title: Facial Recognition Accuracy & Human Review Log
description: A log documenting demographic-disaggregated accuracy testing for a facial-recognition system and, for each match acted upon, confirmation that a trained human independently reviewed it before any adverse action.
evidence_description: A record of a facial-recognition system's tested false-match rate by demographic group, and, for every match that led to a customer-facing action, documentation that a trained human independently confirmed the match beforehand.
collection_method: Automated logging of match/confirmation events, combined with periodic independent accuracy testing.
artifact_format: Structured export (CSV/JSON) of match/confirmation events; PDF summary of accuracy testing results.

citations.title: Rite Aid Banned from Using AI Facial Recognition After FTC Says Retailer Deployed Technology without Reasonable Safeguards
